editor.nameDescription: Use slashes '/' in prompt names to organize them into folders.
editor.promptDescription: Define your prompt template. You can use {{variable}} to insert variables into your prompt. Note: Variables must be alphabetical characters or underscores. You can also link other text prompts using the plus button.
editor.configDescription: Arbitrary JSON configuration that is available on the prompt. Use this to track LLM parameters, function definitions, or any other metadata.
editor.commitMessageDescription: Provide information about the changes made in this version. Helps maintain a clear history of prompt iterations.

labels.promptLabelsDescription: Use labels to fetch prompts via SDKs. The production labeled prompt will be served by default.

actions.deletePromptConfirm: This action permanently deletes this prompt. All requests to fetch prompt {promptName} will error.
actions.deleteVersionConfirm: This action deletes the prompt version. Requests of version {version} of this prompt will return an error.
actions.duplicateAllVersions: Copy all prompt versions and labels

detail.titleTooltip: Prompt names cannot be changed. Instead, duplicate this prompt to a different name.
detail.helpDescription: You can use this prompt within your application through the Langfuse SDKs and integrations. Refer to the documentation for more information.
detail.immutableNote: Prompts are immutable in Langfuse. To update a prompt, create a new version.
detail.seeDocumentation: See documentation for more details on how to use prompts in frameworks such as Langchain.
